title: Diagnose a missing image Compose cannot build, instead of relaying the cascade
reviewer: review-383-2 (Claude Opus 5, independent; did not author the implementation under review)
conditions-status: both MEDIUM findings fixed by the author on the same branch before close, each with a test and a negative control; see the card's §리뷰가 바꾼 것 section

unverified-assumption-closed.question: does `docker compose config --format json` emit `build` as null for an image-only service, or omit it?
unverified-assumption-closed.measured: Docker Compose 5.5.1, darwin/arm64, throwaway compose file, `config --format json` only — no up/down/pull/build run
unverified-assumption-closed.answer: omitted entirely; the key is absent, not null
unverified-assumption-closed.consequence: hasBuild is correct: nil RawMessage -> "" -> false. Had it tested only `!= "null"` the diagnosis would have gone silent on every real project.
also-measured: short-form `build: .` is normalised to an object, so hasBuild reads it as a value
a service with build: and no image: emits no image key; missingLocalImages skips it on svc.Image == ""
config omits profiled services unless the profile is active; buildArgs injects pctx.ComposeProfiles, so the probe's view of the project matches the up's

reviewer-negative-control.method: six independent mutations to production code, each compile-clean, each reverted; git status empty afterwards

findings.defect: the probe's config call always describes the whole project, because buildArgs appends mode-derived service names only to `up`. A mode with compose_services: [A, B] that fails on a port conflict in A is diagnosed against unrelated image-only service C — a confident wrong answer replacing the real one.
findings.applied: composeConfigJSON now appends the same service selection. buildArgs was deliberately left alone: preflightConfig's `config --quiet` validates the whole project on purpose, and widening this fix there would change behaviour outside the card.

findings.defect: neither probe call is bounded. ExecSubprocessCaptureInDir is a plain CombinedOutput with no context, and `docker image inspect` runs serially once per image. A daemon that answers `docker info` inside its 5s bound and then stalls hangs the probe forever, so `dva up` never returns. docker_daemon.go:10-14 had already bounded itself for this exact reason; the new probe adopted its placement principle and dropped the bound that came with it.
findings.applied: added ExecSubprocessCaptureInDirContext (the unbounded form now delegates to it); the deadline is owned by the whole diagnosis (missingImageProbeTimeout, 20s) rather than per call, because a per-call bound still burns timeout x N; on expiry the probe yields nothing and the original error stands; ctx.Err() is checked before a failed inspect contributes a name, because absent-because-unanswered is not absent.
findings.test: TestComposeUp_StalledInspect_DoesNotHangAndKeepsOriginalError, behind //go:build unix (syscall.Mkfifo). The shim blocks on a fifo with the shell `read` builtin, so the process genuinely stalls; removing the deadline fails the test after 15s.

findings.defect: fixtureMixedProject wrote "build": null, a shape real compose never emits
findings.applied: null pairs dropped; the end-to-end tests now exercise the real omitted shape. hasBuild's doc comment corrected to state the measurement.

findings.defect: the first direction line generalised across the list ("them/they must be pulled or built")
findings.applied: reworded to "compose cannot build any of them, so whichever is the cause must be pulled or built…", keeping the blame scoped the way the next line states it.

findings.defect: a failing up parses the compose file set twice (preflight config --quiet, then probe config --format json)
findings.applied: accepted as-is; daemon-free and cheap, and the two calls answer different questions.

findings.defect: no tasks/doing/ entry, so resolveCardZone returns ok=false and a card's status: is never checked against its directory. ce task lint and tools/planprogress/check.go:99 both classify doing/.
findings.applied: not acted on — outside this card. Recorded here so the gap is not lost.

gates.completion-criteria-bindings: all nine run bare, never piped; every one exit 0
